conventions.missing: Empty or whitespace-only cells; other numeric tokens must be finite numbers.
conventions.distinct: Nonmissing normalized values only; numeric values parsed as float.
conventions.std: Sample standard deviation (n - 1); null for fewer than two values.
conventions.duplicates: After trimming whitespace and parsing numbers; missing cells compare equal.
conventions.scope: Descriptive observed metrics only; no training, formulas, units, or timeline inferred.
